## Description {#details}

<p>This file defines a set of templates that efficiently compute a dominator tree over a generic graph.</p>


<p>This is used typically in LLVM for fast dominance queries on the CFG, but is fully generic w.r.t. the underlying graph types.</p>


<p>Unlike ADT/* graph algorithms, generic dominator tree has more requirements on the graph's NodeRef. The NodeRef should be a pointer and, either NodeRef-&gt;<a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/analysis/basicaliasanalysis-cpp/#a1b8850f1ed44c12bc3501175a71c251c">getParent()</a> must return the parent node that is also a pointer or DomTreeNodeTraits needs to be specialized.</p>


<p>FIXME: Maybe GenericDomTree needs a TreeTraits, instead of GraphTraits.</p>
